info.title: MealConnect API
info.description: Food ordering and restaurant management platform.

schema.title: Response Health Api V1 Health Get

get.summary: Readiness: database and Redis are reachable

post.summary: Create a customer or restaurant-owner account
Exchange email + password for an access/refresh token pair
Rotate tokens: old refresh token is revoked, a new pair is returned
Revoke a refresh token
Change password (signs out all other sessions)

schema.title: Response List Addresses Api V1 Users Me Addresses Get

post.summary: Add an address (the first one becomes the default)

get.summary: List approved restaurants with search, filters, sorting and pagination
Menu grouped by category (unavailable items included, flagged)
My cart with live prices and totals

post.summary: Add an item (one restaurant per cart)
Place an order from the cart (status PENDING_PAYMENT)

get.summary: Order details with status timeline (for tracking)

post.summary: Cancel before the restaurant accepts (refund if paid)
Rate a delivered order (once)
Start payment for a PENDING_PAYMENT order
Payment gateway webhook (HMAC-signed, idempotent)
SANDBOX ONLY: simulate the gateway completing or declining the payment
Raise a complaint (optionally about an order)
Mark all as read

schema.title: Response My Restaurants Api V1 Owner Restaurants Get

post.summary: Register a restaurant (starts as pending until an admin approves)

get.summary: Full menu as customers see it

schema.title: Response List Categories Api V1 Owner Restaurants  Restaurant Id  Categories Get

post.summary: Create a category

delete.summary: Delete a category (its items become uncategorized)

schema.title: Response List Items Api V1 Owner Restaurants  Restaurant Id  Menu Items Get

post.summary: Add a menu item

delete.summary: Delete a menu item (soft delete; order history is kept)

patch.summary: Mark an item available / sold out

post.summary: Accept a PLACED order
Reject a PLACED order with a reason (customer is refunded)

patch.summary: Advance an order: PREPARING -> OUT_FOR_DELIVERY -> DELIVERED

get.summary: Sales analytics for a date range (default: last 30 days)

patch.summary: Suspend or reactivate a user (suspension signs them out everywhere)
Approve, reject or suspend a restaurant

post.summary: Force-cancel an unfinished order (refunds if paid)

patch.summary: Assign, update or resolve a complaint

AddressUpdate.title: AddressUpdate
AddressUpdate.description: PATCH: every field optional; only the fields sent are changed.

ErrorResponse.title: ErrorResponse
ErrorResponse.description: Shape of every error response — documented in OpenAPI via `responses=`.

OwnerRestaurantRead.title: OwnerRestaurantRead
OwnerRestaurantRead.description: Owners and admins also see moderation status.
